page.title: Tools
page.description: Format JSON and JSON Lines, inspect Unicode text and links, and generate BibTeX citations in your browser.
page.heading: Research and developer tools
page.intro: Format datasets, examine text, build citations, and check link destinations. The tools process your input in your browser.

output.copyFailed: Select and copy the output manually.

data.title: JSON and JSON Lines
data.description: Indent JSON or validate a dataset with one JSON value per line. Formatting preserves large numbers and key order.

unicode.title: Unicode text
unicode.description: Normalize text while retaining accents and language-specific letters. Inspect the characters stored in a transcript or corpus.
unicode.nfdLabel: NFD · decompose into base and marks

citation.title: BibTeX citation
citation.description: Build a citation from publication details you’ve verified. Separate multiple authors with “and”.

links.title: Link inspector
links.description: Parse a link locally to see its destination and spot misleading details.
links.destinationNote: Compare the hostname with the address you expect before entering credentials.
